testsuite.name: org.mozilla.fenix.browser.permissions.OriginBoundPermissionsDialogFragmentTest

testcase.name: cancel drops the pending rerun and a later request starts a fresh run
normal settings exclude private and other container requests
refreshes never overlap and requests made meanwhile collapse into one more run
a load that fails while Gecko registers its listener is retried
a load that keeps failing reports the last error after the allowed attempts
session and remembered permissions expose their actual lifetime
frame explanation names the exact requesting scheme and port plus the top site
private permission never shows a checked persistent choice even for malformed persistent input
